import os
import runpy
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root_argument = Path(sys.argv.pop(1))
package_root = root_argument if root_argument.is_absolute() else Path(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT', '.'))
package_root = package_root.resolve()
server_script = package_root / 'server' / 'thread_tree_mcp.py'
os.chdir(package_root)
sys.argv[0] = str(server_script)
runpy.run_path(str(server_script), run_name='__main__')
